summary: iter297 cleanup + P1 features verified. All 8 iter297 tests pass standalone (5.45s). Combined iter290-297 suite passes 69/69 when run with rate-limit cooldown between login-heavy tests. Live curl smoke against the preview backend confirms: users_router is registered (/api/users/{id}/profile-summary returns 200), pickup-confirm endpoints respond with correct 401/404/200 codes, admin/flag-stuck-transactions sweep returns {flagged:0} as expected on a clean db, deposit-release logic + bilingual notifications + Pillow JPEG generation + DeprecationWarning shim all green in pytest.

minor.issue: Login rate-limit (429) hits within iter290-297 combined run because every iter296+iter297 test re-logs the admin. Tests retry-pass when run after a ~75s cooldown. Cosmetic; suggest a session-scoped login fixture for the iter296/iter297 tests to halve admin-login calls.

action_items: Optional: refactor iter296/iter297 tests to share a module-scoped admin-token fixture so the combined suite doesn't hit /api/auth/login rate-limit (429). The current behavior is by-design rate-limit protection on the prod-verified login endpoint; not an iter297 regression.
critical_code_review_comments: services/pickup_confirmation.py correctly gates VEHICLES path away from auto-refund and instead emits an admin bell-icon notification (data.action=deposit_release_required) — matches the iter297 spec.
Stripe Refund.create() is gated on payment_intent_id startswith('demo_') AND on STRIPE_API_KEY presence — correct, prevents network calls in demo data.

Pillow generator returns a valid JPEG (SOI 0xFFD8) and the meta_feed_mapper + google_feed_mapper both prefer listing.placeholder_image_url before falling back to SECTION_PLACEHOLDERS — verified end-to-end via test_feed_placeholder_sweep_stamps_url.
DeprecationWarning fires on services.email_notifications import — message contains 'deprecated' and references bucketed modules + iter310 removal target. Good migration hygiene.
PickupConfirmButton.js uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, gates by role + 7-day window, falls back gracefully on missing winner_user_id (winner_id / highest_bidder_id) — solid drop-in component.
users_router was previously dead code (imported, never included). The :816-820 wiring in server.py fixes that — locked in by test_users_router_is_registered.

rca of the issue: N/A — no iter297 bug. The cold-run 429 is /api/auth/login's per-IP rate-limit firing because both iter296 and iter297 admin-login back-to-back in the same suite. Reproduces deterministically when both test files run sequentially. Mitigated by cooldown / shared-token fixture.
